post.title: Nvidia Fell 13% Last Week While AMD Jumped 19% 📉
post.description:
Nvidia (NVDA) fell 12.7% in the week of Nov 9–13 while AMD rose 18.9%. Nvidia's Friday close of $162.85 was its lowest in more than eight months, 31.9% below its Oct 6 close.

The week's big movers (Nov 13 close vs Nov 6 close):
📈 Cerebras Systems (CBRS) +21.2%
📈 AMD +18.9%
📈 Broadcom (AVGO) +18.2%
📉 Moderna (MRNA) −12.1%
📉 Nvidia (NVDA) −12.7%
📉 Alibaba (BABA) −13.8%

Since the chip crash on Nov 5 (vs the Nov 4 close):
📈 AMD +9.3%
📉 Micron (MU) −2.1%
📉 Nvidia (NVDA) −18.6%

S&P 500 (SPY): +2.6% · Nasdaq 100 (QQQ): +3.6% · Dow (DIA): +2.1%

Nvidia reports earnings on Tuesday, Nov 17, after the close.

AMD or Nvidia: which would you pick? Tell me in the comments.
Subscribe for the market's biggest moves every trading day.

Moves use official closing prices. Data: Robinhood. Narrated with an AI voice. Not financial advice.
